references.text: A parallel account where Joshua sends the people away to their inheritance after they had completed the task of taking possession of the land.
Describes how the tribes were to receive their allotted portion in the land, which is now fulfilled as Joshua sends them to their inheritances.
Joshua sends the tribes of Reuben, Gad, and half the tribe of Manasseh back to their inheritance on the east side of the Jordan, a similar event.
Judges describes the time after the people were sent to their inheritances, where each man did what was right in his own eyes.
The conclusion of the allotment of land where the tribes received their territories, which they are now sent to.
